flows.name: An incoming claim: an agent reviews it, a lawyer decides where it is not standard (LEGALFLY)
flows.summary: LEGALFLY's Legal Workflows page, in its claim example: a workflow starts where the request arrives, an agent reviews the case facts against the policy terms, a threshold check sends the standard ones through and escalates the rest to legal review, with a person in the loop, and the assessment is documented and filed. Its other examples (contract intake, NDAs, vendor contracts, terminations) follow the same pattern.

steps.what: A claim comes in, by email, Slack, Teams or by hand, and starts the workflow the legal team built or chose from LEGALFLY's pre-built ones.
Reviews the case facts against the policy terms.
steps.agent: Review the claim against the policy.

steps.what: Checks value and complexity against a threshold: a standard claim goes on, one above it is escalated.
Reviews the escalated claim (human in the loop).
Documents and files the claim assessment, and notifies whoever the workflow names.
